name: @thetis/config-probe
description: A tool package for tests: reports the configuration it received and keeps documents through env.storage().

token.help: A secret the tests set at a person's layer.

greeting.help: A plain key with a default.

mode.help: Set by an admin for everyone.

tools.name: probe_config
